welcome.text: Welcome to IPSW Manager 4.0. This wizard will guide you through the initial configuration. You can change any of these settings later from the app's Settings page.
welcome.feature1: Parallel chunk downloader with resume support — up to 16 threads
welcome.feature2: SSD-aware I/O scheduling and direct offset-based chunk merging
welcome.feature3: Parse firmware file names — extract device, version & build info
welcome.feature4: Auto-cleanup: remove duplicate, outdated and corrupted firmware files

download.title: Download Settings
download.subtitle: Configure how IPSW files are downloaded and stored.
download.saveDir.label: Save Directory
download.saveDir.desc: Destination folder for all downloaded IPSW files
download.turbo.label: Turbo Mode
download.turbo.desc: Maximize parallel download chunks (up to 16). Recommended for 100Mbps+ connections.
download.skipVerify.label: Skip Verification
download.skipVerify.desc: Bypass SHA-256 checksum check after download completes. Not recommended.

firmware.title: Firmware Settings
firmware.subtitle: Manage how firmware files are parsed and maintained.
firmware.parse.label: Parse File Name
firmware.parse.desc: Extract device model, iOS version and build identifier from IPSW filenames automatically.
firmware.removeOld.label: Auto Remove Old Firmware
firmware.removeOld.desc: Keep only the latest build per device. Older versions will be removed on startup.
firmware.removeDupe.label: Auto Remove Duplicate Firmware
firmware.removeDupe.desc: Find and remove duplicate IPSW files.
firmware.removeInvalid.label: Auto Remove Invalid Firmware
firmware.removeInvalid.desc: Delete corrupted or incomplete IPSW files detected during startup scan.
firmware.linkOutDir.label: Output folder name
firmware.linkOutDir.desc: Folder name for IPSW file hard links (relative to save directory)
